decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s established offer, remains prominently presented on its own page in 2024, and with strong sector knowledge and in-house R&D the firm is well placed to keep learning from and improving it.

Although its visibility fell from a standalone page to a website mention in 2024, it is still close to the firm’s core tariff and calculation capabilities, so a medium German software firm with its own R&D would more likely retain it than abandon it.

Because it builds on the firm’s established data, process and integration know-how and likely supports the broader platform strategy, the firm has good absorptive capacity to refine it even if it is no longer marketed as a standalone highlight.
